'''turtau''' are tanru or parts of tanru that have a fixed meaning, which depends on this structure.

===turtau classes===
Common usage may use lo turtau with different meanings.
====seltau that are adjectives/adverbials====
# '''barda''' seltau. '''lo barda broda''' = '''lo broda noi barda''', ''lo broda, which is big''.
# '''cmalu''' seltau. '''lo cmalu broda''' = '''lo broda noi cmalu''', ''lo broda, which is small''.
# '''zabna''' seltau.
# '''mabla''' seltau.
====others====
# '''mutce''' seltau. '''mutce broda''' unwraps into '''mutce lo ka ce'u broda'''
# dispreferred: '''simxu''' seltau. '''x1 simxu broda x2''' expands into '''x1 ce x2 simxu lo ka ce'u broda ce'u''', ''x1 and x2 reciprocally broda''
